# Education

[](mailto:didattica@museonivola.it)

**At Museo Nivola we believe in the educational role of Art.**

To support our educational offer, we can help organizing snacks and quick lunchs for the participants to our labs.

Info and bookings:  
tel: 0784/730063  
e-mail: [info@museonivola.it](mailto:didattica@museonivola.it)

[](mailto:didattica@museonivola.it)

SCHOOLS

The museum offers a portfolio of educational activities for schools of all levels, to encourage active participation and the acquisition of knowledge and skills in the fields of artistic techniques and art history. Our workshops promote the free expression of creativity. The activities are customizable and adaptable to every need.

KIDS & FAMILIES

Museo Nivola is child-friendly: the permanent collection and the exhibitions stimulate curiosity; the park offers a safe and welcoming playground. The Museum organizes workshops for children and families.

Discover our monthly program on our calendar, or call to book a customized workshop.

TEENS & GROWNUPS

The museum organizes and hosts workshops and masterclasses led by artists and art professionals, for youngsters, art lovers, artists and creative people interested in cultural tourism.

# Facilities

CAFÈ

Our cafè is open according to the museum hours and on special events. In collaboration with Strada del Vino Cannonau, it offers aperitifs and wine tastings.

BOOKSHOP

In the bookshop it is possible to buy a curated selection of art books, design objects, fine Sardinian handicrafts, and the exclusive museum edition devoted to Nivola. Discover more or buy on line on our **[SHOP](http://shop.museonivola.it/)**

CORPORATE AND PRIVATE EVENTS

It is possible to rent the museum spaces for conferences, presentations, aperitifs, dinner, and meetings. The museum park is also available for non religious weddings and wedding parties.

# What to do in Orani

What to see, where to eat, where to stay.

Orani is renown for his craftsmen and craftswomen: tailors and stonecutters, metalsmiths and woodworkers.

The mines in its surroundings make Orani one of the most important centers of the Geominerary Park of Sardinia.

The Sanctuary on Monte Gonare is one of the most beautiful in the whole island, both for its medieval church and for its position in the landscape.
